notes:
Account summary: CopperBridge builds safety-critical control software for manufacturing lines (PLC integrations, firmware). Evaluating enterprise code assistant to speed feature dev and reduce review time while preserving auditability and residency. Primary ask: a private/VPC-hosted IDE copilot with streaming completions inside VS Code, ability to pin model versions (for reproducible approvals), and full audit logs + retention control.

Recent timeline / activity: 
- 2026-02-25: 60min demo + VS Code streaming proof-of-concept (Sofia, Ravi, CTO Daniel Ortega, Lead SRE Maya). Showed low-latency streaming from dedicated pool; CTO asked about on-prem package.
- 2026-02-18: Security kickoff (Maya Chen + CopperBridge security). Provided SOC2 questionnaire; requested KMS and HSM design.
- 2026-02-10: Fireflies ff-20260210-8473 - initial requirements call; prioritized VPC-only traffic, zero egress of source code, and model pinning for audits.
- 2026-01-30: POC scope agreed: 2-week private deployment in staging, 50 dev seats, VS Code extension integration, latency/throughput baseline runs.
- 2025-12-12: Intro meeting; moved from discovery -> evaluation.

Technical requirements / constraints: 
- Latency: interactive completion streaming target < 50ms token-to-client on internal LAN; tail latency 95th < 120ms for small completions.
- Throughput: support ~400 concurrent developer sessions during peak (auto-scaling preferred).
- Model/versioning: must be able to pin to certified model binary (e.g., rbw-code-v2.1) and roll forward with canary. Need immutable model hashes in audit logs.
- Streaming: token-by-token streaming to IDE plugin required (no buffering >200ms).
- Fallbacks: automatic fallback to quantized local variant during capacity spikes; audit trail must record fallback events.
- Data controls: all request/response logs kept in-customer VPC or encrypted at rest with customer KMS; retention windows configurable down to 90 days or up to 7 years for compliance.
- SSO/SAML: SSO enforced (Okta), RBAC integration required.

- KMS integration design in review (network asked for HSM support).
- Pen test scheduled after staging POC (ticket SEC-1187).
